title: Quaint Yeasty Australian Pineapple Skewers
description: A kid-friendly Australian dish featuring rum, steam, and yeasty flavors, this recipe is egg-free and perfect for a snack or dessert. The combination of pineapple, coconut, and spices creates a unique and delicious taste experience.
instructions: Preheat a steamer basket over boiling water.
In a large bowl, combine pineapple chunks, coconut milk, dark rum, yeast, brown sugar, shredded coconut, cinnamon, and vanilla extract.
Mix well until the pineapple is evenly coated with the mixture.
Thread the pineapple mixture onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the steamer basket and steam for 10 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the steamer and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the skewers warm, garnished with additional shredded coconut if desired.
